description: 한국서부발전(주)_신재생 설비운전·발전량/태양광·풍력 발전량 정보 조회 서비스 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국서부발전(주). 설비운전·발전량/태양광·풍력 발전량 정보 조회 서비스는 장치아이디, 절대시간, 로컬시간, 온도, 전압(R, S, T), 전류(R, S, T), 역률(R, S, T), 주파수, 순시전력. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국서부발전(주). Its tags are 전력량, 전압, 전류, 온도, 주파수. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
